acme.orders.lookup@1.entry: SELECT order_id, status FROM orders WHERE order_id={order_id}

acme.orders.search@1.entry: SELECT order_id, status FROM orders WHERE customer_name ILIKE {query} ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 50

acme.orders.aggregate@1.entry: SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

acme.orders.update_status@1.entry: UPDATE orders SET status={status} WHERE order_id={order_id}
